title: vibeX docs lock — what the last check established
description: Written next to the docs spec and committed with it. It lets a build re-read only the anchors whose files git says have moved, and it carries the commit each claim last verified at so that fact survives a build which reused the result. Not hand-written; delete it to force a full check.

commit.description: HEAD when this lock was written. The next build diffs against it; if it cannot (unknown commit, shallow clone, rewritten history) it re-checks everything.

claims.description: One entry per anchored claim. Assertions are not here: they go stale on a clock, not on a file.

hash.description: The hash the spec declared when this entry was written. If the spec's hash differs now, the claim was re-anchored or rewritten and is re-checked regardless of what git says.

commit.description: The commit this claim last verified at, carried forward across builds that reused it.
